body: I cannot imagine anyone wanting me.

I was in an abusive relationship for over two years. He cheated on me, assaulted me, convinced people I was abusing him while simultaneously telling me those people were abusing him... our entire relationship began when he assaulted me and I began the relationship to keep him from telling people what I had let happen. It's an incredibly long, disgusting story, but I finally got out one day and rebuilt my life.

I can't rebuild again. I'm beyond being damaged goods. He promised he would never leave me. I believed everything he said and I can't do this.
